data.name: Nikunj
data.long_meaning: Nikunj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Nikunj’ which means ‘young one’ or a ‘delightful place’. This name is often associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to have spent his childhood in a grove, a Nikunj. It represents joy, happiness, and the innocence of childhood.
